run_test_on_slurm: run the test_net.py submission script to execute distributed model testing on a SLURM cluster via submitit
create_trainer_checkpoint: create a Trainer checkpoint that requeues a delayed submission with the same args for SLURM job recovery
setup_gpu_args: setup GPU args by appending the SLURM job_id to the output directory path for experiment tracking
build_slurm_executor: build a submitit AutoExecutor configured for 8 GPUs per node with 45GB memory and 16-hour timeout on the dev partition
test_main_distributed: test the main entry point that parses CLI args, configures distributed settings, and submits the Trainer job to SLURM
